actions.name: curve right in the dark (left wheel 40 %, right 20 %)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve right at 40/20; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left at 10/40; else curve right at 40/10.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line in the light, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim light: it curves right at 40/20 and reads nothing else
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no black: it curves right at 40/10
